_doc: Phase-gate manifest for agents/roadmaps/road-to-typescript-only-scripts.md (Phase 1 Step 10). Each entry maps a migration phase (2-12) to the migration_status.ts categories it owns. `status` is flipped by the migration orchestrator as phases run: 'pending' (not started — no gate enforced), 'in-progress' (phase_gate.ts reports the remaining tracked .py count, informational), 'complete' (phase_gate.ts asserts ZERO tracked .py files remain in the phase's categories — violation fails CI). Sequencing rule: a phase may only be 'in-progress' or 'complete' if every lower-numbered phase is also 'in-progress' or 'complete' (no later phase starts while an earlier one is still 'pending'). The 'installer' category is shared by phases 3 and 11: phase 3 ports the installer, phase 11 finalizes it — its .py files must be gone before phase 11 can be marked complete. Checked by src/scripts/parity/phase_gate.ts (CI: .github/workflows/migration-gates.yml).
